description: Routes voisines sur la commune de Lille is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Municipality of Lille. By the law of April 10, 1841, the municipalities were obliged to draw up an atlas of the neighborhood roads. The municipality of Lille consists of 4 sub-municipalities, each with its own atlas. In this dataset, these 4 atlases are brought together. The dataset contains only the sentiers. Coverage: Municipality of Lille. The portal shows the English title as "Neighbouring roads in the municipality of Lille" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Municipality of Lille. Its keywords include VOETWEGEN, SENTIERS, STRAATNAMEN, GEMEENTE LILLE, ATLAS DER BUURTWEGEN, BUURTWEGEN IN DE GEMEENTE LILLE. The listing shows 2004-01-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
